column1: # Ishaan — image manifest for scripts/optimise-project-images.mjs
# Columns: old_path <TAB> new_path <TAB> alt
# Alt written 12 Aug 2026 from contact sheets 03, 04, 06 and 07, plus
# direct renders of 17, 34 and 35.
# NINE of Ishaan's ten photographs are here. Index 17,
# /images/Project_Images/Ishaan/DSC_0101.jpeg, is deliberately NOT
# migrated — see IMAGE-ROLLOUT-STATUS.md. It is the entrance arch of
# "महात्मा फुले कला, विज्ञान व वाणिज्य महाविद्यालय, पनवेल /
# M PA SC COLLEGE, PANVEL", photographed with its security guard and a
# parked car. It sits in Ishaan's gallery captioned "Ishaan — exterior of
# the building". Same class of problem as Shaurya's gram panchayat frame:
# a third party's building filed as a project exterior. Whether a
# neighbourhood landmark belongs in the gallery is the owner's call.
# IMG20260627122601%20(1).jpeg is URL-encoded in the data and has a real
# space on disk (§10.4), and image-audit.mjs drops parenthesised names
# from rename-map.tsv, so exterior-04 and -05 were numbered by hand.
# Ishaan is under construction and pre-launch, so bare shells, brick
# infill and workers at the plaster are current fact, not a §6.7 problem.
# All twelve units are 1RK (§4), so a room in this building is a 1RK.
